hadi-march/ui#frame.name: frame
hadi-march/ui#frame.doc: Build a modal frame (overlay + panel). Must run inside an owner; the frame unregisters and restores focus on cleanup.
hadi-march/ui#frame.tr: Kipli bir çerçeve kurar (örtü + panel). Bir sahip içinde çalışmalı; temizlikte çerçeve kaydını siler ve odağı geri verir.

hadi-march/ui#frameSize.name: frameSize
hadi-march/ui#frameSize.doc: The frame (fw × fh px) in a view of vw × vh px for a state: aspect-fitted, centered.
hadi-march/ui#frameSize.signature: function frameSize(st: CropState, vw: number, vh: number): [number, number]
hadi-march/ui#frameSize.tr: Bir durum için vw × vh px görünümdeki çerçeve (fw × fh px): en-boy oranına sığdırılmış, ortalanmış.

hadi-march/ui#freeKey.name: freeKey
hadi-march/ui#freeKey.doc: A key not used in `obj`: base, base2, base3 …
hadi-march/ui#freeKey.signature: function freeKey(obj: Record<string, unknown>, base: string = "key"): string
hadi-march/ui#freeKey.tr: `obj` içinde henüz kullanılmayan bir anahtar üretir: base, base2, base3 sırasıyla.

hadi-march/ui#getAt.name: getAt
hadi-march/ui#getAt.doc: Value at a path (array of keys / indexes) inside a JSON value, or undefined.
hadi-march/ui#getAt.signature: function getAt(root: unknown, p: JsonPath): unknown
hadi-march/ui#getAt.tr: Bir JSON değeri içindeki yoldaki (anahtar / indeks dizisi) değer, yoksa undefined.

hadi-march/ui#gradientCss.name: gradientCss
hadi-march/ui#gradientCss.doc: CSS of a gradient (stops sorted by position).
hadi-march/ui#gradientCss.tr: Bir gradyanın CSS'i (duraklar konuma göre sıralanır).

hadi-march/ui#GradientEditor.name: GradientEditor
hadi-march/ui#GradientEditor.doc: Gradient editor: `<GradientEditor bind:value={$css} />`. The value is a CSS gradient.

props.name: types
props.doc: Types offered (default linear, radial, conic).

props.name: presets
props.doc: Preset gradients: a CSS gradient or a list of colors / theme tokens. Default: HADİ and theme gradients; false hides them.

props.name: output
props.doc: The CSS output with a copy button (default true).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#GradientEditor.tr: Gradyan düzenleyicisi: `<GradientEditor bind:value={$css} />`. Değer bir CSS gradyanıdır.

hadi-march/ui#Grid.name: Grid
hadi-march/ui#Grid.doc: Responsive grid that never overflows: fixed or auto columns, fill and balance the last row, equal row heights.

props.name: cols
props.doc: Columns 1–6 (default 2); collapses to 2 on tablets (4+ columns) and 1 on phones.

props.name: min
props.doc: Auto columns of at least this width ("16rem") instead of a fixed count.

props.name: fill
props.doc: Last row: "stretch" — its items share the row's remaining space equally; "last" — only the last item grows into it (with `cols`). Default: aligned columns with a gap at the end.

props.name: balance
props.doc: Pick the column count that spreads items evenly over the rows (5 in 4 columns → 3 + 2, not 4 + 1). CSS only.

props.name: minCol
props.doc: Narrowest column (default "9rem"): when the box is too narrow for `cols` of this width, fewer columns are used.

props.name: equal
props.doc: Every row as tall as the tallest, across the whole grid. With `cols` it combines with `fill` (span mode: the last row is filled AND all rows are equal). Cards in one row are always equal height.

hadi-march/ui#Grid.tr: Asla taşmayan duyarlı ızgara: sabit ya da otomatik sütunlar, son satırı doldurma ve dengeleme, eşit satır yükseklikleri.

hadi-march/ui#HADI_RING.name: HADI_RING
hadi-march/ui#HADI_RING.doc: The four HADİ colors: Heyecan, Aktivite, Dostluk, İletişim (a theme that defines its brand tokens wins).
hadi-march/ui#HADI_RING.tr: Dört HADİ rengi: Heyecan, Aktivite, Dostluk, İletişim (marka belirteçlerini tanımlayan tema önceliklidir).

hadi-march/ui#heartBurst.name: heartBurst
hadi-march/ui#heartBurst.doc: Throws a particle burst (and a ring) from the center of `host` (give it position: relative).
hadi-march/ui#heartBurst.signature: function heartBurst(host: HTMLElement, o: BurstOptions = {}): void
hadi-march/ui#heartBurst.tr: `host` merkezinden bir parçacık patlaması (ve halka) fırlatır (host'a position: relative verin).

hadi-march/ui#heartPop.name: heartPop
hadi-march/ui#heartPop.doc: Pops a heart: squash, overshoot, settle (on) or a small press (off).
hadi-march/ui#heartPop.signature: function heartPop(el: Element, on: boolean): void
hadi-march/ui#heartPop.tr: Kalbi zıplatır: sıkışma, aşma, yerleşme (açık) ya da küçük bir basış (kapalı).

hadi-march/ui#hsvToRgb.name: hsvToRgb
hadi-march/ui#hsvToRgb.doc: HSV(A) to RGB(A): h 0–360, s / v 0–1, r g b 0–255.

hadi-march/ui#htmlToMarkdown.name: htmlToMarkdown
hadi-march/ui#htmlToMarkdown.doc: HTML (a web page, an office suite, the clipboard) → Markdown, through the safe content core's allowlist.
hadi-march/ui#htmlToMarkdown.tr: HTML (web sayfası, ofis paketi, pano) → Markdown; güvenli içerik çekirdeğinin izin listesinden geçirilir.

hadi-march/ui#IconButton.name: IconButton
hadi-march/ui#IconButton.doc: Icon-only button. `label` is required (aria-label + tooltip title). `<IconButton icon="✕" label="Close" onClick={…}/>`
hadi-march/ui#IconButton.tr: Yalnızca simgeli düğme. `label` zorunludur (aria-label + ipucu başlığı). `<IconButton icon="✕" label="Close" onClick={…}/>`

hadi-march/ui#IconTile.name: IconTile
hadi-march/ui#IconTile.doc: An icon in a tinted rounded square: `<IconTile icon={users} tone="primary" />`
hadi-march/ui#IconTile.tr: Renkli yuvarlak köşeli karedeki simge: `<IconTile icon={users} tone="primary" />`

props.name: src
props.doc: Image URL (same origin, data: or blob:, so the canvas can read it).

props.name: alt
props.doc: Accessible description of the image.

props.name: aspect
props.doc: Fixed aspect (width / height); omitted: the aspect choices decide.

props.name: aspects
props.doc: Aspect choices (default free, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 3:4, 9:16); false hides them.

props.name: maxZoom
props.doc: Highest zoom (default 4).

props.name: preview
props.doc: A live preview of the result (default true).

props.name: api
props.doc: Receives the cropper API.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: step
props.doc: ArrowUp / ArrowDown step (display units).

props.name: scale
props.doc: Display = value × scale.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#initials.name: initials
hadi-march/ui#initials.doc: Initials for a name ("Ada Lovelace" → "AL"), locale aware upper casing.
hadi-march/ui#initials.tr: Bir ad için baş harfler ("Ada Lovelace" → "AL"), dile uygun büyük harfe çevirme.

hadi-march/ui#inputFor.name: inputFor
hadi-march/ui#inputFor.doc: The component for a schema field (null for hidden fields).
hadi-march/ui#inputFor.tr: Bir şema alanının bileşeni (gizli alanlar için null).

hadi-march/ui#insertAfter.name: insertAfter
hadi-march/ui#insertAfter.doc: Insert `value` after `p` (in an array) or after key `p` with `key` (in an object).
hadi-march/ui#insertAfter.signature: function insertAfter(root: unknown, p: JsonPath, value: unknown, key?: string): unknown
hadi-march/ui#insertAfter.tr: `value` değerini `p`'den sonra (dizide) ya da `key` ile `p` anahtarından sonra (nesnede) ekler.

hadi-march/ui#isAction.name: isAction
hadi-march/ui#isAction.doc: Is the value an action() object?
hadi-march/ui#isAction.signature: function isAction(v: unknown): v is Action

hadi-march/ui#isMac.name: isMac
hadi-march/ui#isMac.doc: True on Apple platforms (⌘ is the primary modifier).

hadi-march/ui#isSafeLink.name: isSafeLink
hadi-march/ui#isSafeLink.doc: True for URLs safe to link: http(s), mailto, tel and relative ones (never javascript:, data:, vbscript: …).
hadi-march/ui#isSafeLink.tr: Bağlantı için güvenli URL'lerde true: http(s), mailto, tel ve göreli olanlar (asla javascript:, data:, vbscript: …).

hadi-march/ui#isSep.name: isSep
hadi-march/ui#isSep.doc: Is this menu entry a separator ("-" or `{ separator: true }`)?
hadi-march/ui#isSep.signature: function isSep(it: MenuItem): it is "-" | { separator: true }
hadi-march/ui#isSep.tr: Bu menü girdisi bir ayraç mı ("-" ya da `{ separator: true }`)?

hadi-march/ui#itemVisible.name: itemVisible
hadi-march/ui#itemVisible.doc: Is this menu entry shown for `args` (action guard, `hidden`, `can` permission)?
hadi-march/ui#itemVisible.signature: function itemVisible(it: MenuItem, args: unknown[]): boolean
hadi-march/ui#itemVisible.tr: Bu menü girdisi `args` için görünür mü (action koruması, `hidden`, `can` izni)?

hadi-march/ui#JsonEditor.name: JsonEditor
hadi-march/ui#JsonEditor.doc: JSON editor with a text and a tree view: `<JsonEditor bind:value={$data} mode="tree" schema={schema} />`. Value: the parsed JSON (null when empty); while the text is invalid the raw string.

props.name: validate
props.doc: Extra check of the parsed value → message or null.

props.name: schema
props.doc: JSON Schema subset (see TreeEditor): problems are listed in the text view and marked on the tree rows.

props.name: indent
props.doc: Format indent (2).

props.name: tabIndent
props.doc: Tab inserts two spaces (default true).

props.name: mode
props.doc: First view (default "text").

props.name: modes
props.doc: Views offered (default text and tree); one hides the switcher.

props.name: expand
props.doc: Tree levels open at start (default 2).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#JsonEditor.tr: Metin ve ağaç görünümlü JSON düzenleyicisi: `<JsonEditor bind:value={$data} mode="tree" schema={schema} />`. Değer: ayrıştırılmış JSON (boşken null); metin geçersizken ham dize.

hadi-march/ui#key.name: key
hadi-march/ui#key.doc: Register a global shortcut. Returns an unregister function (also called automatically with the current owner). `combo` e.g. "mod+k", "/", "shift+?" ("g u" sequences are not supported; single chords only).
hadi-march/ui#key.signature: function key(combo: string, fn: (e: KeyboardEvent) => unknown, opts: KeyOptions = {}): () => void
hadi-march/ui#key.tr: Genel kısayol kaydeder. Kaydı kaldıran bir işlev döndürür (mevcut sahip ile otomatik de çağrılır). `combo` örn. "mod+k", "/", "shift+?" ("g u" dizileri desteklenmez; yalnızca tek tuş birleşimleri).

hadi-march/ui#KeyframeTimeline.name: KeyframeTimeline

props.name: renderTarget
props.doc: Draws a preview target (default: a labelled pill in the track's color).

props.name: snap
props.doc: Snap step in ms (default 50; 0 turns snapping off).

props.name: autoplay
props.doc: Start playing when shown (default false).

props.name: loop
props.doc: Loop (default true).

props.name: stage
props.doc: Preview stage over the lanes (default true).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#KeyframeTimeline.tr: Anahtar kare zaman çizelgesi düzenleyicisi: `<KeyframeTimeline bind:value={$timeline} />`.

hadi-march/ui#KeyValueEditor.name: KeyValueEditor
hadi-march/ui#KeyValueEditor.doc: Edit an object of string → string (or number with `numbers`). Rows keep their order; empty keys are skipped; duplicate keys are flagged. Props: keyPlaceholder, valuePlaceholder, numbers (numeric-looking values become numbers).

props.name: numbers
props.doc: Numeric-looking values become numbers.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#KeyValueEditor.tr: Dize → dize (`numbers` ile sayı) nesnesini düzenler. Satırlar sırasını korur; boş anahtarlar atlanır; yinelenen anahtarlar işaretlenir. Prop'lar: keyPlaceholder, valuePlaceholder, numbers (sayıya benzeyen değerler sayı olur) ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/ui#LikeButton.name: LikeButton

props.name: onToggle
props.doc: Called with the next state; the owner updates `liked` (and the count).

props.name: color
props.doc: Heart color while liked. Default brand-pink.

props.name: burst
props.doc: Particle burst on like. Default true.

props.name: colors
props.doc: brand: particles in the four HADİ colors · single: the heart color. Default brand.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name. Default "Like".

hadi-march/ui#LikeButton.tr: `<LikeButton liked={$liked} count={$likes} onToggle={(on) => { $liked = on; $likes += on ? 1 : -1 }} />` — beğeni düğmesi.

hadi-march/ui#LinkCard.name: LinkCard
hadi-march/ui#LinkCard.doc: A navigational card: `<LinkCard href="/users" icon={users} title="Members" description="Search and manage" />`

props.name: meta
props.doc: Small text on the right (a count, a status).

hadi-march/ui#LinkCard.tr: Gezinme kartı: `<LinkCard href="/users" icon={users} title="Members" description="Search and manage" />`

hadi-march/ui#ListDetail.name: ListDetail
hadi-march/ui#ListDetail.doc: Master list + detail. On narrow screens only one pane shows: the list, or the detail (with a back button) when `selected` is truthy. `<ListDetail list={<UserList/>} detail={() => <UserDetail id={$id}/>} selected={() => $id} onBack={() => $id = null} />`

props.name: detail
props.doc: The detail pane (a zero-arg function is called when shown).

props.name: selected
props.doc: Truthy when an item is selected (narrow screens then show the detail).

hadi-march/ui#ListDetail.tr: Ana liste + ayrıntı. Dar ekranlarda yalnızca bir bölme görünür: liste, ya da `selected` doğruysa ayrıntı (geri düğmesiyle). `<ListDetail list={<UserList/>} detail={() => <UserDetail id={$id}/>} selected={…} />`

hadi-march/ui#ListEditor.name: ListEditor
hadi-march/ui#ListEditor.doc: Edit an array of strings: add, remove, move up/down; pasting several lines adds one item per line. Props: placeholder, max (items), unique (default true), addLabel.

props.name: max
props.doc: Most items.

props.name: unique
props.doc: Skip duplicates (default true).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#ListEditor.tr: Dize dizisini düzenler: ekle, sil, yukarı/aşağı taşı; birden çok satır yapıştırmak her satıra bir öğe ekler. Prop'lar: placeholder, max (öğe), unique (varsayılan true), addLabel.

hadi-march/ui#Loader.name: Loader
hadi-march/ui#Loader.tr: Tüm alanı kaplayan döner gösterge: `<Loader text="Loading users…" />`

hadi-march/ui#loadTheme.name: loadTheme
hadi-march/ui#loadTheme.doc: Load a theme's stylesheet once (<link rel="stylesheet">, CSP style-src 'self'); resolves when it is ready (or failed).
hadi-march/ui#loadTheme.tr: Bir temanın stil sayfasını bir kez yükler (<link rel="stylesheet">, CSP style-src 'self'); hazır olunca (ya da başarısız olunca) çözülür.

hadi-march/ui#LocaleSelect.name: LocaleSelect
hadi-march/ui#LocaleSelect.doc: `<LocaleSelect options={[{ value: "en", label: "English" }, { value: "tr", label: "Türkçe" }]} />` (strings allowed)

props.name: options
props.doc: Locales: `{ value, label }` or plain strings.

hadi-march/ui#LocaleSelect.tr: `<LocaleSelect options={[{ value: "en", label: "English" }, { value: "tr", label: "Türkçe" }]} />` — dil seçici (dizeler de kabul edilir).

hadi-march/ui#MadeWithMarch.name: MadeWithMarch
hadi-march/ui#MadeWithMarch.doc: `<MadeWithMarch />`, `<MadeWithMarch variant="badge" />`. The sentence is one i18n message, so word order follows the language.

props.name: variant
props.doc: `text` (plain line, default), `badge` (bordered pill), `small` (compact, muted).

hadi-march/ui#MadeWithMarch.tr: `<MadeWithMarch />`, `<MadeWithMarch variant="badge" />`. Cümle tek bir i18n iletisidir; sözcük sırası dile göre değişir.

hadi-march/ui#MARCH_URL.name: MARCH_URL
hadi-march/ui#MARCH_URL.doc: Where "HADI March" links point (badge and console banner).
hadi-march/ui#MARCH_URL.tr: "HADI March" bağlantılarının işaret ettiği adres (MadeWithMarch rozeti ve konsol afişi). Değiştirilecek tek yer. Not: hedef https://devs.hadisosyal.com/march olacaktır, ancak bu sayfa henüz yayımlanmadı.

hadi-march/ui#Markdown.name: Markdown
hadi-march/ui#Markdown.doc: Render Markdown safely. Props: source (or a string child), images (default true, https only), newTab (default true).

props.name: children
props.doc: A string child (when no `source`).

props.name: images
props.doc: Render https images (default true).

props.name: newTab
props.doc: Open http(s) links in a new tab (default true).

props.name: headingOffset
props.doc: Added to heading levels (max h6).

hadi-march/ui#Markdown.tr: Markdown'ı güvenle çizer. Prop'lar: source (ya da dize alt öğe), images (varsayılan true, yalnızca https), newTab (varsayılan true).

props.name: view
props.doc: First view (default "write"; "split" when `preview="split"`).

props.name: views
props.doc: Views offered, in order (default write, preview, split, rich). One view hides the switcher.

props.name: preview
props.doc: Older form of `view`: "tab" (write / preview tabs) or "split".

props.name: toolbar
props.doc: Formatting toolbar over the source (default true).

props.name: syncScroll
props.doc: Source and preview scroll together in the split view (default true).

props.name: stats
props.doc: Words and reading time under the editor (default true).

props.name: split
props.doc: Split share of the source pane, 0–1 (default .5).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#markdownNodes.name: markdownNodes
hadi-march/ui#markdownNodes.doc: Parse Markdown into DOM nodes (never HTML strings). HTML in the source is shown as text.
hadi-march/ui#markdownNodes.signature: function markdownNodes(source: unknown, opts: MarkdownOptions = {}): Element[]
hadi-march/ui#markdownNodes.tr: Markdown'ı DOM düğümlerine ayrıştırır (asla HTML dizesi değil). Kaynaktaki HTML metin olarak gösterilir.

hadi-march/ui#Marquee.name: Marquee
hadi-march/ui#Marquee.doc: A ticker: `<Marquee text="…" />` = OverflowText that loops whenever it is on screen.

props.name: text
props.doc: The text (or pass children).

props.name: trigger
props.doc: When to scroll (default hover + focus). "hover"/"focus" listen on the nearest link, button or list item.

props.name: mode
props.doc: bounce: to the end and back (default) · loop: endless ticker with a separator · once: to the end and back, one time.

props.name: speed
props.doc: Pixels per second (default 40).

props.name: pause
props.doc: Hold at each end, ms (default 1000).

props.name: delay
props.doc: Wait before starting after the trigger, ms (default 250).

props.name: separator
props.doc: Loop separator (default "•").

props.name: fade
props.doc: Fade the clipped edges (default true); false shows an ellipsis instead.

props.name: play
props.doc: Extra condition that keeps it scrolling (e.g. the selected item of a menu): `play={() => isActive()}`.

props.name: host
props.doc: Element whose hover/focus starts it (default: closest a, button, li, label, [tabindex] — or itself).

hadi-march/ui#Marquee.tr: Kayan yazı: `<Marquee text="…" />` = ekrandayken sürekli dönen OverflowText.

hadi-march/ui#Media.name: Media
hadi-march/ui#Media.doc: `<Media src kind alt poster controls autoplay loop muted size class />` (size: "sm" thumbnail, "md"). Video and audio show controls unless `controls={false}`. When the element fails to load, `fallback` (default "Could not load media") is shown instead.

props.name: size
props.doc: "sm" thumbnail, "md".

props.name: fallback
props.doc: Shown when loading fails (default "Could not load media").

hadi-march/ui#Media.tr: `<Media src kind alt poster controls autoplay loop muted size class />` (size: "sm" küçük resim, "md"). Video ve ses, `controls={false}` olmadıkça denetimleri gösterir. Öğe yüklenemezse `fallback` gösterilir.

hadi-march/ui#MediaGrid.name: MediaGrid

props.name: max
props.doc: Tiles shown before "+N". Default 4 (2…4).

props.name: shape
props.doc: auto: the single photo keeps its shape · square · portrait (4:5). Default auto.

props.name: gap
props.doc: Space between tiles: none · thin (2px) · gap. Default thin.

props.name: onDoubleTap
props.doc: Double tap on a tile (like). Single taps then wait 230 ms.

hadi-march/ui#MediaGrid.tr: `<MediaGrid items={post.media} onOpen={(i) => openLightbox(post.media, i)} onDoubleTap={like} />` — medya ızgarası.

hadi-march/ui#mediaKind.name: mediaKind
hadi-march/ui#mediaKind.doc: Guess the kind of a URL from its extension ("image" when unknown).
hadi-march/ui#mediaKind.tr: Bir URL'nin türünü uzantısından tahmin eder (bilinmiyorsa "image").

hadi-march/ui#Menu.name: Menu
hadi-march/ui#Menu.doc: Dropdown menu. items: [{ label, onSelect, icon, href, danger, disabled, hidden, can, shortcut } | action | "-"]. `<Menu label="Row actions" icon="⋯" items={[edit, remove, "-", { label: "Open", href: "/x" }]} args={[row]} />` Keyboard: ↓/↑ on the trigger opens, ↑ ↓ Home End move, Enter activates, Esc closes, Tab leaves.

props.name: label
props.doc: Trigger text and accessible name.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Icon-only trigger.

props.name: trigger
props.doc: Custom trigger content.

hadi-march/ui#Menu.tr: Açılır menü. items: [{ label, onSelect, icon, href, danger, disabled, hidden, can, shortcut } | action | "-"]. `<Menu label="Row actions" icon="⋯" items={[edit, remove, "-", { label: "Open", href: "/x" }]} />`

hadi-march/ui#menuItems.name: menuItems
hadi-march/ui#menuItems.doc: The enabled `role="menuitem"` elements of a menu panel, in order (roving focus moves among them).
hadi-march/ui#menuItems.tr: Bir menü panelinin etkin `role="menuitem"` öğeleri, sırayla (gezici odak bunlar arasında dolaşır).

hadi-march/ui#mix.name: mix
hadi-march/ui#mix.doc: Blend two RGBA colors (t = 0 → a, 1 → b), in sRGB.
hadi-march/ui#mix.signature: function mix(a: Rgba, b: Rgba, t: number): Rgba
hadi-march/ui#mix.tr: İki RGBA rengini sRGB'de karıştırır (t = 0 → a, 1 → b).

hadi-march/ui#model.name: model
hadi-march/ui#model.doc: Two-way value model for a control. Works with `bind:value` (getter `value` + `setValue`), a signal passed as `value`, a live `value` getter + `onChange`, or an uncontrolled initial `value`. Returns [get, set]; `set` also calls onChange(v).
hadi-march/ui#model.signature: function model<T>(props: object, def: T, name: string = "value"): [get: () => T, set: (v: T) => void]
hadi-march/ui#model.tr: Bir denetim için çift yönlü değer modeli. `bind:value` (getter `value` + `setValue`), `value` olarak verilen sinyal, canlı `value` getter'ı + `onChange` ya da denetimsiz başlangıç `value` ile çalışır. [get, set] döndürür.

hadi-march/ui#MoneyInput.name: MoneyInput
hadi-march/ui#MoneyInput.doc: Money: NumberInput with the currency symbol on the locale's side and the currency's decimals (2 for most). Props: currency.

props.name: currency
props.doc: ISO 4217 code (default "USD").

props.name: step
props.doc: ArrowUp / ArrowDown step (display units).

props.name: scale
props.doc: Display = value × scale.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#MoneyInput.tr: Para: para birimi simgesi dilin tarafında ve para biriminin ondalıklarıyla (çoğunda 2) NumberInput. Prop'lar: currency.

hadi-march/ui#MultiSelect.name: MultiSelect
hadi-march/ui#MultiSelect.doc: Multiple choice with chips; same props as Combobox (static options or async search). Value: array.
hadi-march/ui#MultiSelect.tr: Çipli çoklu seçim; Combobox ile aynı prop'lar (statik seçenekler ya da eşzamansız arama). Değer: dizi.

hadi-march/ui#NavMenu.name: NavMenu
hadi-march/ui#NavMenu.doc: items: [{ id, title, href, icon?, group?, badge?: () => number, keywords?, can?, hidden? }]

props.name: items
props.type: MaybeFn<readonly (NavItem | null | undefined | false)[] | null | undefined>

props.name: storageKey
props.doc: localStorage key for pins, recents and collapsed groups (default "hm.nav").

props.name: filter
props.doc: false: no filter box.

props.name: palette
props.doc: false: do not register the pages with the command palette.

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: Show a button that collapses the sidebar to an icon rail (state persists).

props.name: groupsCollapsed
props.doc: Groups start collapsed; the group of the active page opens itself.

props.name: groupIcons
props.doc: Icons for group headings (also the default icon of the group's items): `{ "Billing": wallet }`.

hadi-march/ui#NavMenu.tr: items: [{ id, title, href, icon?, group?, badge?: () => number, keywords?, can?, hidden? }]

hadi-march/ui#NavSidebar.name: NavSidebar
hadi-march/ui#NavSidebar.doc: Side menu: groups, search, recent and featured items, collapsible rail, resizable width, remembered state.

props.name: items
props.type: MaybeFn<readonly (NavSidebarItem | null | undefined | false)[] | null | undefined>

props.name: title
props.doc: App name (bold) or any node; optional second line.

props.name: featured
props.doc: Highlighted items at the top (e.g. a support inbox with a live count).

props.name: recent
props.doc: How many recent visits to show (default 5, 0 = off).

props.name: groupOrder
props.doc: Category order: "alpha" (default, locale collation), "none" (as given) or explicit names first.

props.name: itemOrder
props.doc: Item order inside a category: "alpha" (default) or "none".

props.name: groupIcons
props.doc: Icons next to category names (and the default icon of their items).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Categories open on first visit: "active" (only the one with the current page, default), "all" or "none".

props.name: hotkey
props.doc: Ctrl+K: focuses this search box ("focus", default) or belongs to a <CommandPalette> on the page ("palette": only the hint is shown here, the palette opens); false = no shortcut and no hint.

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: Collapse to an icon rail (button in the header; state persists).

props.name: storageKey
props.doc: localStorage key (default "hm.sidebar").

props.name: width
props.doc: Starting width: px (number) or a CSS length ("18rem"). Default 17.5rem.

props.name: resizable
props.doc: A grip on the inner edge changes the width (drag, touch, ← → Home End on the focused grip, double click resets).

props.name: minWidth
props.doc: Narrowest / widest width the grip allows, px (default 200 / 480).

props.name: onResize
props.doc: Called with the new width in px while resizing (and once it ends).

props.name: persist
props.doc: Remember the width (default true when resizable): in the sidebar's storage, or under this localStorage key.

props.name: collapseBelow
props.doc: Dragging narrower than this (px) switches to the icon rail; dragging wider again restores the labels.

props.name: palette
props.doc: false: do not register the items with the command palette.

hadi-march/ui#NavSidebar.tr: Yan menü: gruplar, arama, son ve öne çıkan öğeler, daraltılabilir ray, yeniden boyutlandırılabilir genişlik, hatırlanan durum.

hadi-march/ui#normalizePhone.name: normalizePhone
hadi-march/ui#normalizePhone.doc: Normalize a typed phone number to "+" and digits; `country` ("+90") is prepended to national numbers.
hadi-march/ui#normalizePhone.signature: function normalizePhone(raw: unknown, country?: string | null): string
hadi-march/ui#normalizePhone.tr: Yazılan telefon numarasını "+" ve rakamlara çevirir; `country` ("+90") ulusal numaraların başına eklenir.
